title: Good but not great
text: Good but not great. I got this to replace a 10+ yo bissell carpet cleaner. It works as expected but like any shampooer it is not a miracle worker. There are 3 major things I do not like about it that are design flaws. 1. When water/shampoo tank is full it's a bit top heavy. If you're not paying attention and it falls over all the water in the tank is going to come out very quickly. 2. The dirty water reserve isnt sealed so to speak. When removing it to empty you can slosh the dirty water out and if you do not carry it right, and I'm not sure what right is because i keep spilling it, it will drain out on you and the floor. And 3, the place that sucks up the water from the carpet will get choked with hair and debris no matter how much you pre vaccum and you will spend forever trying to get it out. I found a plastic zip tie is the right thickness, because it's a very thin opening, works and you just keep jamming it in until the debris comes out the other end. If I knew all this beforehand I would not have purchased.  I cannot return as I've used it a couple times and it was almost an emergency situation why I needed it immediately. There are many other brands in this price range to try. With any shampooer I highly recommend pre vacuuming very thoroughly and making sure to clean out the shampooer of any hair or debris after every use.
